problem_type: Planned/test-only scaffolding promoted to performance evidence without a measurement contract
symptom: PR1172 declared broad workflow coverage although actions were partial or absent and elapsedMs included waits/collection; empty reports could succeed.
direct_cause: Fixture envelope passed as record; partial P/C gestures and D/B/A/R placeholders; nonvalidated CLI; date-only output; missing probe became empty data; scalar percentiles reused as raw observations.
class_root: No shared boundary validated action identity, browser milestones, raw distributions, coverage lifecycle and report acceptance independently.
affected_population: Every workflow action, cache/scale combination and future report consumer
Linux/native-display/CI runs, reload and missing probe, empty/planned/partial samples
entry_points: workflow CLI runner and sample lifecycle
internal_only_reason: This is an internal test/evidence contract; no third-party runtime behavior is changed. Existing Electron43.4.1, Playwright and launch/network guard remain pinned.
invariants: Actual trusted input and attributable visible/ready/ack marks belong to one document/probe and clock; decoded visible content and persisted-data receipts are required
No fixed waits or collection in latency; raw action-window entries preserved and clipped for metrics
Each sample has isolated fixture/profile; cache dimensions stay separate
Only implemented actual actions can execute; planned differs from environment-blocked; incomplete evidence never passes
Fixture counts derive from persisted content and match12/48/320 shots and4/48/320 references; production normalization must retain mixed groups and result history

door_reduction.why_not: The tool uses symbol names: same-name writeReport/runCell entries outside this workflow are not shared implementations and must remain for their separate domains. The runner produces observations, the summarizer consumes them, and focused tests exercise the boundary; these separate roles cannot be merged. All workflow-specific producer/consumer doors converge on the one contract.

generality_proof: Producer and consumer both use the same normalized sample, raw aggregation and acceptance facts. Missing/replaced document, invalid CLI and empty/legacy/unsupported pass claims fail closed for every scale/cache. Full journeys remain nonexecutable planned rows.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate browser marks/document identity and derive clipped action-window observations
Isolate fixtures/profiles, preserve attempts, separate planned/blocked/invalid/executed
Reject untrusted legacy/empty samples and unsupported pass flags; pool raw distributions

same_class_entry_points.evidence: CLI and every repetition now use parseOptions, normalizeActionSample, applyCellVerdict and reportExitCode.
Schema1 elapsedMs no longer feeds visible latency; schema2 empty/invalid samples cannot produce success.
Independent historical schema/contract is not this workflow producer; its outputs are labelled legacy/untrusted by the new analysis, never imported as acceptance.

recurrence.reason: Any future action/platform/reload or empty CLI can reproduce the same missing invariant; an observed launch error never proves implementation or performance.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs normalizeActionSample summarizeCell writeReport runCell createNomiUserWorkflowFixture buildAnalysis --roots=tests/ux,scripts --include-tests
Compared workflow loop and summarize-nomi-user-performance consumers; inspected canvas-only benchmark as independent schema
Read actual ProjectLibraryPage click handler, canvas data-ready, DocumentListSidebar selectors, shell drawers/stepper,17-kind registry and full-walk catalog

prevention.invariant: No consumer may certify incomplete/legacy/invalid measurements or use percentile-of-percentiles as raw data.
prevention.failure_mode: Nonzero acceptance status and explicit planned/blocked_environment/invalid/inconclusive evidence; historic raw retained.
prevention.strategy: Normalize and validate before aggregation; independently revalidate report samples and refuse acceptance for actions whose full metric contract is not implemented.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed partial P1/P2/C branches, fixture-only execution placeholders,250ms delay/elapsedMs, silent probe fallback and scalar quantile aggregation. Same files now expose only the atomic action and contract; historical raw stays unmodified.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade is involved; measurement/report invariants are repository-owned. Runtime archive installation is environment provisioning at declared43.4.1, not a product change.

migration: Schema1 raw remains immutable historical launch evidence; schema2 consumers reject it as timing input. Full journey IDs are planned; project.open names its smaller action explicitly.
residual_risks: Real browser/display execution must be separately recorded; Node mechanism/injected-lifecycle tests are not product acceptance
Main long tasks/CPU distributions/memory and teardown trends unimplemented; performance pass disabled
Full88-entry solo baselines,pairwise and higher-order journeys remain planned
No native Mac/Windows,real GPU/private asset/account or packaged-release baseline
